items.title: KISI BEEMAR NE KHAT APNE MASIHA KO LIKHA
items.body:
kisi beemar ne khat apne masiha ko likha
haal bimariyo'n ka beti ne baba ko likha
jo bhi armaan tha dil me shah-e- waala ko likha aur salaam apna phupi saniye zehra ko likha
dil me qush thi ke mera qat jo pahonch jayega
hai yaqee'n ab koi lene ke liye aayega
<<DIVIDER>>
qat me alqaab ye bekas ne kiya tha marqoom
chahne waale pidar mere imam-e- mazloom
raat din roti padi rehti hu ab to maghmoom
aap to bhoolgaye qair ye mera maqsoom
<<MINI>>
na gilaa tum se hai na koi shikayat baba
haan mubarak ho sakina se mohabbat baba
<<DIVIDER>>
qair tum ko na sahi, mujh ko hai tum se ulfat
kisi surat mujhe dikhlaao tum apni surat
jaanti hoon ke sakina pa bahut hai shaffqat
accha aye baba bahan ki mai karoongi qidmat
<<MINI>>
mujh ko bulwake wahaa'n mera bhi dil shaad karo
lo kanizi me sakina ki mujhe yaad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
gar nahi mujh ko bulate ho to aao baba
shouq se apni sakina ko bhi laao baba
usko sine pa sulaate ho sulaao baba
ham ko rulwate ho to qair rulaao baba
<<MINI>>
ranj sahti huwi dunya se guzar jaaungi
aap aaye nahi ek roz mai marjaaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
aarzu hai ke kisi tour yahan aajaye'n
aap ki jaan se door, aah jo ham marjaaye'n
apne hathou se kafan aap mujhe pahnaaye'n aur takleef lahad tak bhi zara farmaaye'n
bas zyada na sawari yaha'n tehraiyega
dafn karte hi mujhe aap chale jaaiyega
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ko marqoom tha aye madar-e- farqanda siyar
saqt baba ki tarha karliya tumne bhi jigar
aas bachne ki nahi lijiye ab jald qabar
warna bimaar ka ab hota hai dunya se safar
<<MINI>>
nahi ummed ke bach jaaye ye muztar amma
doodh ab baqsh do bimaar ko aakar amma
<<DIVIDER>>
tha raqam hazrat-e- zainab ko phupi nek qisaal
tum ko bhaiyya ali akbar se mohabbat hai kamaal
haaye har dam mujhe reh reh ke ab aata hai qayaal ke mera bhai pa bhari hai ye attharwa'n saal
haan tasadduq ke liye der na farmaaiyega
sadqe hone ke liye bhai pa bulwaaiyega
<<DIVIDER>>
tha alamdar ko tahreer ke abbas chacha
door uftada bhatiji se huwe tum bhi qafa
sunte hai aapki har baat ko mere baba
mujh ko bulwaaiye, ya laaiye unko mai fidaa
<<MINI>>
chumungi unke qadam tumko duaa'en doongi
unki bhi aur tumhari bhi balaye'n loongi
<<DIVIDER>>
likha akbar ko ke aye baap ke pyare akbar aur phupi jaan ke bhi raaj dulaare akbar
mere baba ki zaeefi ke sahare akbar
hai ye bimaar bahan gor kanaare akbar
waada lejaane ka tha dekhiye kab aate hai'n
aap to aate nahi qalq se ham jaate hai'n
<<DIVIDER>>
tha qitaab asghar-e- nadaa'n se ke aye rashk-e- qamar
ghutniyo'n bhi na chale ho gaya darpesh safar
mujh ko har dam tera rehta hai qayaal aath (8) pahar
sote ho jhule me ya jaagte ho aye asghar
<<MINI>>
neend aaram se aur chain se aati hogi
jab sakina tere jhoole ko jhulati hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aate hai tumhare wo jhundule mujhe baal
sadosi saal salaamat raho aye mere laal
tumko bimaar bahan ka nahi maloom ahwaaal
mout nazdeek hai aur zouf-o- naqahat hai kamaal
<<MINI>>
mai jo marjaau'n kahi'n bhool na jana asghar
ghutniyo'n chalte huwe qabr pa aana asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye na tha ilm use kat gaya sarwar ka gala
qasim-o- akbar-o- abbas huwe shah pa fida
teer kha kar ali asghar bhi gaye sooe baqaa
baaqi ek bhai tha sajjad so wo qaid huwa
<<MINI>>
maa, phupi, bahne'n luti qaime bhi taraaj huwe
ek chaadar ko haram shaah ke mohtaaj huwe

items.title: AYE MOMINO HUSSAIN SE MAQTAL QAREEB HAI
items.body:
aye momino hussain se maqtal qareeb hai
aaqir hai umr manzil-e- awwal qareeb hai
shahr-e- madina door hai jangal qareeb hai
zehra ka chand chupta hai baadal qareeb hai
<<MINI>>
lene ke waaste malakul mout aate hain
marqad ko apne paau se shabbir jaate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
al qissa sub'ha manzil-e- aaqir ayaa'n huwi lekin ye sub'ha sibte nabi ko kaha'n huwi
jis jaa sawari ruk ke na aage rawaa'n huwi
hairaa'n sipaah qusra o koun-o- makaa''n huwi
che ghode badle dosh-e- nabi ke sawaar ne lekin qadam badhaya na ek raahwaar ne
<<DIVIDER>>
jumbish na markabou'n me na paayi hussain ne
ek mushk qaak jhuk ke uthaayi hussain ne
qud sunghi aur bahan ko sunghaayi hussain ne
hamsheer ki suni ye duhaayi hussain ne
<<MINI>>
hai hai ye qaak phainko meri jaan jaati hai
bhaiyya tumhare qoon ki bu is me aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bashindou ko waha'n ke, ye moula ne di nidaa
naam is zamee'n ke jitne ho lo tum juda juda
wo bole aap ko ho mubarak har ek balaa
ye nainawa hai, maariya hai, aur karbala
<<MINI>>
maabood ye qaleel ka gunbad maseeh ka
sheh bole ab ye hoyega madfan zabeeh ka
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko pukare na aage alam badhaao
manzil yahi hai chaauni pardesiyou ki chaao
hamshakl-e- mustafa ko nida di badhe na jaao
beta qanaate'n ghero saraache yahi'n lagao
<<MINI>>
ghurreh ko to huwa hai hamara safar tamaam
daswi'n ko hoga fatima zehra ka ghar tamaam
<<DIVIDER>>
al qissa qaime hogaye istaada ja baja aur qaimou me utarne lage aale mustafa
dyodi se par kajaawa e zainab nahi mila
khud ehtemaam karne lage shah-e karbala
roki qanaat akbar-o qasim ne aan kar
abbas gird phirne lage naiza taan kar
<<DIVIDER>>
masnad pa yaa'n bithaa ke behen ko shah -e- huda
kursi bichaa ke baithe qaribe haram sara
the dast basta gird jawanaane baawafa
leleke nazre'n aaye zamee'n daare karbala
<<MINI>>
istaadah farte gham se jo shabbir hogaye
nazrou pa haath rakh ke baghal geer hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
bithlake pahluo'n me unhe ye kiya bayaa'n
aye karbalaiyo main tumhara hoon mehmaa'n
zalim mujhe sataate hai jata hoon main jahan
becho jo ye zameen to chand din rahoon yahaan
<<MINI>>
rehne se yaa'n hamare sab aaram paayenge
khaake shifa tumhari zameen ko banayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
deenaar deke saath(60) hazaar unko ye kaha
mai ne tumhe ye baqshi zamee'n tum karo hiba
shabbir ke muaamle par sab ne ro diya
likhne laga qabala zami'ndaare karbala
<<MINI>>
ghul padgaya hussain watan ko na jayenge
lo mol li zamee'n yahi'n basti basayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
marqoom horaha tha qabala ke naagahaa'n
qaime se ek zan-e- arabiya huwi ayaa'n
sar ta qadam naqaab se saara badan nehaa'n par uspa bhi haya se larazte the isteqaa'n
betaab hoke ulfate akbar me aayi thi
raavi ne ye likha hai wo zehra ki jaayi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
lekar balae'n bhai ke kuch kaan me kaha aur jald yu phiri ke na saaya nazar pada
kursi se yaa'n tadap ke gire shah-e- karbala
abbas ne utha ke kaha haaye kya huwa
moula bataa qasam tujhe sheere butool ki
kya keh gayi nawasi janabe rasool ki
<<DIVIDER>>
shah bole aah mujh se ye zainab ka tha kalaam
bhaiyaa qabale me ali akbar ka hove naam
yani ke uski milk me ho ye zami'n tamaan
abbas jaao kehdo ke majboor hai imaam
<<MINI>>
atthara saal ke ye zamane se jaayenge
ek qabr ki jagah ali akbar bhi paayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas aaye qaime me kehne ko ye payaam
zainab ne dekhte hi unhe ye kiya kalaam kyu bhai meri baat pa raazi huwe imaam
likha gaya qabale me akbar ka mere naam
dulha banaaungi mai dulhan biyaah laungi
akbar ke naam ki yaha'n basti basaungi
ab waqt hai dua ka ke hai shiddat -e buka
aamee kahe dabeer mohib-baane murtuza
ya rab hai jitne shiyya sultaane laafata
maqsad bar aaye sabke ma-e baaniye aza
ya rab na koi gham ho inhe juz ghame hussain
in dosto ke haath ho aur maatame hussain

items.title: SHAHEED SE KOYI SHAMSHEER KA MAZAA POOCHE
items.body:
shaheed se koi shamsheer ka mazaa pooche
mareez se koi akseer ka mazaa pooche
aseer se koi zanjeer ka mazaa pooche
yateem se koi dilgeer ka mazaa pooche
<<MINI>>
har ek pa guzra zamane me ranj-o- gham hai hai
sahaa na aabid-e- beemar sa alam hai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed hote huwe baap ko pisar dekhe
ani pa naize ki hai hai sar-e- pidar dekhe
jawaan bhaai ka nikla huwa jigar dekhe
phupi ko aankho'n se balwe me nange sar dekhe
<<MINI>>
kisi nabi pe na is tarha ke alam guzre
jo is mareez pa har tarha ke sitam guzre
<<DIVIDER>>
shadeed tap me wo kaanto'n pa chalna aabid kaa
pahan ke bediyaa'n har ek qadam pa gir padnaa
wo zulm-o- jor-e- sitamgar haram ka shor-e-bukaa
wo jisme-laaghare aabid wo dhoop wo durra
<<MINI>>
siwaaye shukre quda kuch na kehte the sajjad
duaa-e- ummat-e- aasi me rehte the sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
phiraaya kaanto'n pa sajjad ko barahnaa paa
nabi ke kunbe ko balwe me le gaye aadaa
jalaaya qaima-e- naamoose syed-e- waala
phiraake balwe me zindaa'n me qaid kardaala
<<MINI>>
tamaasha dekhne sab ehle shaam aate the
hayaa se ahle haram gardan-e jhukaate the
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ke baad huwa qaid se jo chutkaara
laee'n se baap ka sar is yateem ne maanga
sare hussain qazaane se hind ne bheja
sawaar oonto'n pa kunba huwa payambar ka
<<MINI>>
lahad me laash gharibo'n ki haaye dharne chale
mah-e- butool ko paivand-e- qaak karne chale
<<DIVIDER>>
jo pahonche karbobala aabide aseere balaa
pidar ko deke kafan qaak me rakha laasha
lipat ke qabr se chillaaye yu ke aye baba
watan ko jaata hoo'n lo aaqri mera mujraa
<<MINI>>
watan se aaya tha kis shaan se yahaa hai hai
lutaa ke ghar ko mai jaata hoo'n neem jaa'n hai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
likha hai yu ke watan aaye jab shah-e-waala
pidar ki yaad me har waqt karte the naala
nazar jo aata tha paani to rote the moula
hamesha aankho'n me phirta tha dasht-e- karbobala
<<MINI>>
pidar ke baad bhi raahat mili na aabid ko
dobaara qaid kiya is ghareeb zaahed ko
<<DIVIDER>>
watan se legaye phir qaid karke baaniye shar
huwi bhatije ke hamraah zainab-e- muztar
qareeb shaam jo pohnche wo dono nouhagar
lagaaya belcha zainab ki pusht ke oopar
<<MINI>>
safar me zainab-e- bekas se chut gaye sajjad
dayaar-e- shaam me phir aake lut gaye sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
phupi ko sounp ke jangal me syed-e- waala
madine me huwa daaqil wo bekas-o- tanha
waleed-e- shaam ke haakim ne zaher bhijwaaya
wo sam ke khaate hi aabid ne ki jahaa'n se qazaa
<<MINI>>
falak pa hoor-o- malak arsh ko hilaane lage
zamee'n pa jinn-o- bashar sar pa qaak udaane lage
<<DIVIDER>>
mohibbo daaghe alam dil pa dhar gaye sajjad
jo khaya zaher to sad haif margaye sajjad
nabi ki aal ko be aas kargaye sajjad
yateem hogaye baaqir guzar gaye sajjad
<<MINI>>
sar apna peet'te marqad se mustafa nikle
kaleja thaamke kyu kar na faatema nikle
<<DIVIDER>>
charaaghe deen-e- nabi aaj bujh gaya yaa rab
nishaan-e- panjetan-e- paak mitgaya yaa rab
uthaa jahaan se sartaaj ab mera yaa rab
qitaab bewa-e- aabid mujhe mila yaa rab
<<MINI>>
karu mai kya meri qismat bigad gayi yaa rab
chaman me faatema ke ous padh gayi yaa rab
<<DIVIDER>>
quda ke arsh ka taara guzar gaya logo
ghazab hai shaah hamaara guzar gaya logo
wo bekaso'n ka sahaara guzar gaya logo
hassan hussain ka pyaara guzar gaya logo
<<MINI>>
madina lut gaya ya mustafa duhaayi hai
najaf ujad gaya ya murtaza duhaayi hai

items.title: Bala uthaake haram karbala se aate hai
items.body:
Balaa uthake haram karbala me aate hai
Mareez shaam ke daarushifa me aate hai
Ajeeb shikwe se dashte bala me aate hai
Ghame hussain me yaade quda me aate hai
<<MINI>>
Jigar ke tukde bhare damanou me aaye hai
Yeh qabr e sheh pe chadhane ko phool laaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bukhar me hai raqam yeh riwayat e jaa'n kaah
Jab aaye ehle haram janibe shahadath gaah
Naa gul na shamma mili bekasou ki qabr pe aah
Mujaveri ko faqat jaaber ibne abdullah
<<MINI>>
Qureshi aaye hai aur hashmi bhi hazir hai
Musaferou ke mujaver bhi sab masafir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Do shamiyaane hai baalaye qabre sibte rasool
Woh ek toh rehmate haq ek dard e aahe batool
Falak se hur o malak ka hai fouj, fouje nuzool
Ziyarate shahe mazloom kar rahe hai husool
<<MINI>>
Lahad se akbar o asghar ke daagh roushan hai
Mazaar ek hai par do charagh roushan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Labe furaat hai saqqa ki qabre aali jaa
Jo woh hai shahr shaheedo ka to yeh shehre panah
Khareeb dur se hai zairo'n ki haafeze raah
Mujaviri ko lahad par hai roohe sher ilaah
<<MINI>>
Lahad me haye sakina ka shor hota hai
Sakina kehti hai saqqa humara rota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Udhar aya'n huvi bus zainab khasta qisaal
Idhar lahad me tadap ne laga rasool ka laal
Nida mazar se jaaber ko di ba ranjo malaal
Mai jeeta hota toh karta bahen ka isteqbaal
<<MINI>>
Sharaf hai fatima ka fatima ki jayi ko
Meri taraf se tu jaa uski peshwayi ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Chala ma'ara faqa jaaber e qasta nehaad
Sare hussain liye hathou par male sajjad
Khadam par gir padha jaaber ba nalao faryaad
Pukari abide bekas ko zainab e nashaad
<<MINI>>
Gale lagalo mohibbe nabi ye jaaber hai
Ye turbat e shahe mazloom ka mujavir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gale laga liya jaaber ko shaahe wala ne
Gale pa neel rasan ke dikhaaye aaqa ne
Kaha ke loot liya bhaai hum ko aada ne
Jo hum pa hogaya hum jaane ya quda jaane
<<MINI>>
Sare hussain badi mehnatou se laaya hu
Dobaara baap ko mai dafn karne aaya hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Mohibbe peetne ki jaa hai aaho wawaila
Gharaz daroode haram qabre shaahe dee'n pa huwa
Qanaat rok ke aabid waha rahe tanha
Khade huwe the bagirde qanaat aale aba
<<MINI>>
Wahaa shigaafta aijaaz se mazaar huwa
Zamee'n ke parde se qursheed aashkaar huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Tane hussain se mu'allaq kiya hussain ka sar
Huwa zameen me goya quraane shamso qamar
Lahad pa taqt kaloobi qareena se rakh kar
Pukaare abid e bekas mohibbo aao idhar
<<MINI>>
Suno ba gosh ke is dam rasool rote hai
Dobara dafn mere baba jaan hote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye kehke rone lage haye abide beemar
Mazaar shaahe gareeba jo ho chuka taiyyar
Sarhane baith ke sab fateha padhe ek baar
Gharaz ke qaima e jaaber me aaye sab deen daar
<<MINI>>
Haram ne qabr pe samane ashke waah kiya
Sare mazaar bapa qaimaye siyaah kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Siyaah qaime me utre siyaah posh haram
Tawafe qabr kiya halqa baandh kar baaham
Sabho'n ne qabr ko baalou se jhada jab usdam
Laraz laraz gayi sadme se qabr e shaahe umam
<<MINI>>
Lahad pa sheh ki masnad bichayi zainab ne
Salaam ke liye gardan jhukayi zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Phupi ke saath sakina ne bhi kiya mujraa
Kaha batao toh bibi mujhe baraye khuda
Mazaar par jo bichayi hai masnade zeba
Nikal ke qabr se baithi ke kya mere baba
<<MINI>>
Kaha phupi ne tera puchna rulata hai
Bhala yu qabr me bhi jake koi aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lipat ke qabr se awaaz di dohayi hai
Ek arbaee'n se bahen bhai me judai hai
Hussain bhai bahen ki bhuki piyasi aati hai
Umeed ware ziyafat yeh amma jayi hai
<<MINI>>
Na farsh hai naa makaa'n hai na dana payi hai
Saqi ke laal yahi meri meh maani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nikalo hath lahad se gale lagalo mujhe
Watan naa jaungi mai qabr me bulalo mujhe
Barehna sar hu ba zere kafan chupalo mujhe
Aqi bala me giraftar hu nikalo mujhe
<<MINI>>
Tumhe sakina ki khatir se ro nahi sakti
Yateem parwari ab mujh se ho nahi sakti
<<DIVIDER>>
suno hussain suno tum se mere sawaal hai do
Jo bhej te ho watan ko toh tum bhi sath chalo
Nahi toh zere qadam apne aye shahe khush qu
Zameene qaake shifa ek lahad ki khatir do
<<MINI>>
Lahad ke saye me mera yahi thikana ho
Tumhari payenti ho aur mera sarhana ho

items.title: Aah huvey Kaaba-e-qurbaani-e-daavar hai Hussain
items.body:
Aah huvey Kaaba-e-qurbaani-e-daavar hai Hussain
Fidyaa-e-ummath-e-marhoom-e-Payambar hai Hussain
Beykas-o-beywatan-o-beydil-o-beypar hai Hussain
Sabr-e-Ayyub ki shamsheer ka jauhar hai Hussain
<<MINI>>
Gohkay talwaar phiree halq pa sattarr baari
Shukr-e-baari kiya pyaasey ney magar har baari
<<DIVIDER>>
Ittefaaq-e-Ulaama ismay hai aye ahley aza
Paanch shartain hai zabeeha kay liye peish-e-Khuda
Sharth-e-awwal hai kay haiwaan na ho bhooka pyaasa
Ehtiyaatan badam-e-zibha bhi doh aabo ghizaa
<<MINI>>
Sharth-e-saani hai kay ho jumah toh taakheer karo
Jumah ko waqth-e-namaaz isko na takbeer karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Teesri sharth hai haiwaan na ho peish-e-haiwaan
Thaadam-e-zibha na hasrath sey ho baaham nigraan
Sharth-e-chahaarum hai kay jaldi na karo taa imkaan
Ho churee teiz magar haath ho narmi sey ravaan
<<MINI>>
Sharth-e-panjum hai churee bhi na dikhaao usko
Zibhaa sey pehlay qazaa sey na daraao usko
<<DIVIDER>>
Zibhey haiwaan ki yeh sharthayn hain magar wawailaa
Ashraf-e-khalq jo tha sibte Nabi noor-e-Khuda
Aah huvey shair-e-Khuda fidyaa-e-Rabb-e-dohsaraa
Khaana kaisa kay na paani usay qaatil ney diyaa
<<MINI>>
Halq tarr karthay hain qassaab bhi qurbaani ka
Qathra ummath ney na Syed ko diya paani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Zibhey haiwaan ka nahin hukm hai haiwaan kay huzoor
Yaan na Shabbir thay kuch door na Zainab thi door
Aal-e-Ahmad dar-e-khaimey pa khadi thi majboor
Lout-thi thi kahin Kubra kahin Abid ranjoor
<<MINI>>
Shah unko woh suey Shaahey Umam dekhtay thay
Zibhaa hothay thay Husain Ahley harum dekhtay thay
<<DIVIDER>>
Manaa dikhlaana churee ka hai paey qurbaani
Yaan tha chey laakh kay narghay main Ali ka jaani
Teigh-o-khanjar liye thay girdh-e-sitham kay baani
Aab-e-aahan kay siwaa tha na mayassar paani
<<MINI>>
Al-atash ki thi sadaa halq-e-Shahey Zeeshaan sey
Pyaas kay maarey zabaan chaabthay thay dandaan sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Eid-e-zilhijja ko hai qurbaani-e-haiwaan illaah
Ho jo ek saal sey kam zibha nahin iska ravaa
Tumko Akbar ki jawaani ki qasam Ahle azaa
Qatl Asghar ko jo ummath ney kiya kya sin thaa
<<MINI>>
Shab-e-haftum sey qalaq doodh na peenay ka thaa
Teesra faaqa tha aur sin chey mahiney ka thaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Na abhi kangee kay qaabil thay jhandolay woh baal
Aah qurbaani-e-Asghar huvi kis tarhaa halaal
Doodh ka hountoun pa aatha tha ishaara na sawaal
Juzz Khuda kuch bhi na pehchaantha tha banu ka laal
<<MINI>>
Maa ka dil iskay ishaarey ko samajh leytha tha
Doodh ki hothi thi khwaahish toh woh rotha tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek bhi daanth na niklaa tha Ali Asghar ka
Ek baalish ka kurtha tha Ali Asghar ka
Chotaa qadh nanhaa sa jhoola tha Ali Asghar ka
Doodh peena bhi na choota tha Ali Asghar ka
<<MINI>>
Moonh sey maa baap ka bhi naam na ek baar liya
Bey zabaan bachchey ko bhi hurmulaa ney maar liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek jaan laakh khareedaar ayaazan billah
Pyaasey par teeroun ki bochaar ayaazan billah
Na koyi yaar na ghamqaar ayaazan billah
Har taraf zaalimo khoonqaar ayaazan billah
<<MINI>>
Apney ruthbey ka kisi ka na shanaasa dekha
Dekha pyaasey ney jisey khoon ka pyaasa dekha
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: SHAH-E WAALA NE SHAHAADAT KA SAR ANJAAM KIYAA
items.body:

tay koi kar na saka jisko wo ye manzil hai

shukr karna jo pinhaye tumhe bhaari zanjeer

unke qaatil se bhi farmaate hai narmi se kalaam

qudrate'n rakh ke giraftaar gaye sabr kiya

qadr baba ki wasiyyat ki dikhaayi tune
qabr haatho'n se sakina ki banaayi tune

yaa ali dekhlo pote ki musibat dekho
gham-o- andoh ki tasweer hai soorat dekho
shiddate- tap se ghazab ki hai naqaahat dekho
touq phir us pa gale me hai qayaamat dekho

waqf-e- aalaam hai hazrat ke gharaane waale

items.title: Durood padhke watak ko chala Hussain ka laal
items.body:
Durood Padh Ke Watan Ko Chala Hussain Ka Laal
Qareeb Pohanchi Madine Ke Jab Rasool Ki Aal
To Apne Haathou Pe Zainab Ne Rakhe Sar Ke Baal
Kaha Madine Se Kulsoom Ne Ba Ranj-O- Malaal
<<MINI>>
Lutaa Ke Aaye Hai Zehra Ke Sab Gharaane Ko
Na Kar Qubool Tu Ham Bekasou Ke Aane Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Madina Ham Tere Waali Ko Aaye Hai Khokar
Madina Gardan-E- Shabbir Par Chala Qanjar
Madina Koofe Me Sar Nange Ham Phire Dar Dar
Madina Daaghe Rasan Hai Hamaare Shaanou Par
<<MINI>>
Ham Aaye Zinda Pa Zehra Ka Noor-E- Ain Nahi
Madina Akbar-O- Qasim Nahi Hussain Nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Hili Zameen Madine Ki Us ghadi Paiham
Kiya Basheer Ko Sajjad Ne Talab Us Dam
Gale Me Shaal-E-Aza Daaldi Ba Deeda-E- Nam Aur Uske Haath Me Rokar Diya Siyaah Alam
Kahaa Ke Jaa Nahi Go Apne Mu Dikhaane Ki Magar Watan Me Qabar Karde Mere Aane Ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Chala Basheer Ye Dete Huwa Qabar Har Jaa Magar Muhalla-E- Haashim Me Dekhta Hai Kya Ke Ek Mariza Sare Raah Hai Khadi Tanha
Jo Naam Poocha To Ro Ro Ke Boli Wo Sughra
Basheer Kehne Laga Kyu Tu Shor-O- Shain Me Hai
Kaha Ye Haal Mera Furqat-E- Hussain Me Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Basheer Samjha Ye Bint-E- Hussain Hai Sughra
Qamoosh Reh Gaya Sughra Ke Mu Pe Kuch Na Kaha
Pukaari Faatema Gardan Me Dekh Shaal-E- Azaa
Tu Bhaai Laaya Hai Kis Ki Sunaani Mujh Ko Sunaa
<<MINI>>
Wo Bola Qaasid-E- Beemaar-E- Karbala Hu Mai
Sunaani Qabr-E- Payambar Pe Le Chala Hu Mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Boli Roroke Bhaai Ye Kya Sunaata Hai
Wo Koun Hai Jise Beemar Tu Bataata Hai
Sunaani Kiski Hai Ye Mujh Ko Haul Aata Hai Ke Mustafa Ki Lahad Se Tu Kehne Jaata Hai
Amaama Phaink Ke Usne Kaha Duhaai Hai
Tere Hussain Ki Sughra Sunaani Aayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamee'n Pa Haaye Pidar Kehke Gir Padi Sughra
Qabar Ye Phaili To Maatam Har Ek Ghar Me Huwa
Tamaam Aurte'n Nikli Gharou Se Karti Bukaa
Nabi Ki Qabr Pa Jaakar Basheer Ne Ye Kahaa
<<MINI>>
Safar Se Lut Ke Idhar Bhooki Pyaasiyaa'n Aayi
Utho Rasool Tumhaari Nawaasiyaa'n Aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Basheer Kehta Hai Wallah Rouza Kaanp Gaya
Lahad Se Naala Huwa Waa Hussain Ka Paida
Idhar Zamee'n Pe Tadapti Thi Faatema Sughra
Zanaan-E- Haashmiya Ne Wahaa'n Hujoom Kiya
<<MINI>>
Hilaa Ke Shaana Kaha Shaah-E- Mashraqain Aaye
Utho Hussain Ke Ashiq Utho Hussain Aaye

items.body:

items.title: CHAHLUM JO KARBALA ME BAHATTAR KA HO CHUKA
items.body:

marjaaye sab yatimou'n ke sar par rahu to mai
